project_info.theme: High-end fashion editorial diptych with silver fringe
project_info.format: one vertical image containing two side-by-side panels
project_info.color_palette: silver, crystal white, dark taupe, warm brown, iridescent shoe highlights, and neutral skin tones

main_subject.detail: same adult woman appears twice with wet-look brushed-back dark hair, soft waves, glowy skin, defined eyeliner, warm blush, glossy nude-pink lips, realistic pores, and joyful confident energy
main_subject.wardrobe: fully opaque shimmering silver beaded halter mini dress densely embellished with crystal beads and sequins, long fringe tassels along the hem, iridescent transparent high-heel sandals with ankle straps, and small elegant stud earrings
main_subject.style: high-end after-party fashion editorial with consistent identity and styling

composition_elements.layout: two-panel vertical diptych inside one image with a clean seam between left and right panels, 4:5 aspect ratio
composition_elements.left_panel: relaxed pose, smiling and looking off-camera
composition_elements.right_panel: playful movement, one leg lifted, laughing, with fringe motion visible
composition_elements.framing: mid-thigh to head, flattering fashion crop, subject centered in each panel
composition_elements.environment: minimal indoor backdrop with smooth dark taupe and brown wall panels, clean modern surfaces, no clutter

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: cinematic fashion flash with soft warm fill, approximately 3800K to 4500K
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: soft frontal flash slightly above eye line, controlled specular highlights on beads, gentle shadows, realistic movement in fringe, glamorous intimate after-party hallway mood

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame fashion camera with 50mm lens, photorealistic editorial diptych
technical_specs.finish: natural skin texture, restrained highlights, fine film grain, accurate crystal and fringe detail, no artificial smoothing

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-end fashion editorial diptych: the same clearly adult woman appears twice side-by-side in two different joyful moments, like a magazine collage. The left panel shows a relaxed pose, smiling and looking off-camera; the right panel shows playful movement with one leg lifted and the adult woman laughing. Both panels feel like the same evening with identical styling. She has wet-look brushed-back dark hair with soft texture and slightly wavy length, glowy skin, defined eyeliner, warm blush, glossy nude-pink lips, realistic pores, and wears a fully opaque shimmering silver beaded halter mini dress densely embellished with crystal beads and sequins, long fringe tassels along the hem that swing with motion, iridescent transparent high-heel sandals with ankle straps, and small elegant stud earrings. Use a minimal indoor backdrop of smooth dark taupe and brown wall panels, a clean seam between two vertical panels, mid-thigh-to-head fashion crops, cinematic fashion flash slightly above eye level with soft warm fill, controlled highlights on beads, natural shadows, and a glamorous intimate after-party hallway mood. Photograph with a 50mm fashion lens, 4:5 aspect ratio, realistic skin and material texture, visible fine grain, and no logos or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, eroticized styling, ambiguous age, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted anatomy, broken diptych seam, malformed fringe, text artifacts
